title: workmux: open worktree
command: workmux project list | while read -r n p; do [ -d "$p" ] || continue; (cd "$p" && workmux ls --json 2>/dev/null) | jq -c --arg n "$n" --arg p "$p" '[.[] | {title: ($n + "/" + .handle), description: (.branch + (if .is_open then " · open" else "" end)), action: {shell: ("cd " + ($p|@sh) + " && workmux open " + (.handle|@sh))}}]'; done | jq -s 'add // []'
emptyText: no worktrees - track a project with `workmux project add`
